what: A WebGL fluid panel covers the whole screen, and mouse travel distance × 5 is used as force to scatter marks (radius .005). Velocity field 128², dye 512², pressure 3 passes, velocity does not decay and only the dye fades by .98 each frame. A faint light (the attached element’s text color) of dye × .03 bleeds out, data-fx-part="mask" When a wordmark (svg) marked this way is on screen, trails passing over it show through only as darker letter shapes at × 3. Drawing rests 300 frames after the hand stops

options.fade: Share of dye left each frame, default .98
options.flow: Share of velocity left each frame, default 1
options.force: Mouse movement (px) to flow force multiplier, default 5
options.idle: Frames until drawing pauses after the hand stops, default 300
options.[data-fx-part=mask]: (if any) a wordmark svg through which the mark shows in letter shapes — anywhere inside the attached element (footer logo). Not used if display:none

note: three must be global (window.THREE) for this to run — load three-global.js before three.cjs. Not attached on touch devices or with reduced motion. The plate stays attached to its element and persists even when the body changes via page transitions (barba), and the wordmark is re-found every 30 frames. The original loads the three 0.157 module
